description_excerpt: Job Description Join LMV (LEGO Manufacturing Vietnam) as a Process Engineer in the NPI team and take ownership of designing and optimizing processes — from new platform introduction through to handover — ensuring quality, productivity, and simplification at every step. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.
